medium.technique: opaque acrylic on stretched woven canvas applied with flat and round bristle brushes
marks: Dry-brush scumbles of white and lavender drag horizontally across the right cheek and whisker bed, skipping over the canvas weave texture.
Thick, directional curved bristle strokes of cadmium orange sweep diagonally down and right across the bib and lower chest.
Sharp, black-violet outline bands form the perimeter of the almond eyes, drawn with a loaded round brush in single fluid loops.
Vertical wet-on-wet blendings of yellow, magenta, and ultramarine streak downwards between the eyes from forehead to muzzle without muddying.
Two distinct pointed dabs of opaque white paint define the tiny lower canine teeth inside the open mouth cavity.
medium.surface: medium-grain primed white cotton canvas, left entirely raw and unpainted across roughly 40% of the field to form the neutral backdrop
medium.edges: abrupt dry-brushed boundaries where outer fur contours feather directly into bare canvas, contrasted with hard graphic outlines encircling the iris and jawline
medium.density: pigment builds in multiple dense, opaque wet layers across the forehead and throat, thinning to single scumbled dry strokes at the lower right chest margin
medium.as_material: heavy ribbons of dyed oilcloth or thick gouache paste scraped flat over open burlap weave

measured.role: unpainted primed canvas ground flanking the head and shoulders
shadowed canvas ground along the upper and left margins
pure cadmium yellow across the right forehead, right eye iris, and lower right torso
deep ultramarine-indigo shading the brow band, cheek patches, and eye outlines
fiery orange marking the left ear tip, bib, and lower neck collar
deep magenta-crimson blocking the left shoulder and forehead bridge
warm neutral ground tone near the outer right boundary
hot bubblegum pink lining the right inner ear flap and upper muzzle

palette.value_structure: High-key open background with stark medium-to-dark saturation within the figure; the deepest value sits inside the pitch-black oral cavity at centre, while the highest values are the bare primed canvas surrounding the silhouette.
palette.temperature: Extremely warm overall due to dominant yellow, orange, and magenta swathes, punctuated by sharp cold accents of deep ultramarine, lilac, and emerald green.

subject.what: domestic cat (Felis catus), head and upper bust
subject.doing: vocalising with an open mouth, caught mid-meow or mid-hiss
subject.pose: frontal bust with the head tilted slightly to the viewer's left while the right ear rises taller to the upper right corner
subject.facing: facing forward toward the viewer with eyes locked squarely on the lens
subject.expression: alert, demanding, and vocal, showing slight surprise or insistent communication through wide pupils and parted lips
subject.stylisation: Fauvist chromatic fragmentation replacing natural tabby or calico fur patterns with unblended slabs of primary and secondary colour

story.nature: a loud, domestic sentinel animal accustomed to demanding immediate attention from humans
story.habitat: a sunlit linoleum kitchen doorway near a food dish
story.implies: the animal has just noticed a pantry door open and has let out an insistent, high-pitched demand
story.world: a chipped ceramic water crock, a low window sill dusted with morning light, and an open cardboard box

composition.mass: heavy pyramidal vertical wedge anchored in the bottom centre-left and tapering up toward the ears

flow_lines.line: diagonal thrust of the right ear contour leading down into the chest
curved collar arc formed by the orange bib under the chin
vertical streak down the bridge of the nose to the lower jaw

composition.negative_space: the upper left, upper right, and lower left canvas margins remain raw primed white, accounting for roughly 40% of the total frame
composition.symmetry: roughly bilateral in head shape, but broken by asymmetrical colour patches and a higher, sharper right ear
composition.scale_cues: the proportion of the canine teeth to the lip margin and the typical diameter of domestic feline irises

focal.what: the dark open triangular mouth revealing pale teeth and lilac tongue

composition.frame: the subject's chest and flanks are cut off abruptly by the bottom edge, while the ears push near the top and side borders

energy.why: Directional brush sweeps of clashing hues race from the throat upward into the brow, frozen at the instant of a vocal cry.

details.what: two tiny conical white canine teeth puncturing the black oral gap
details.where: lower centre, inside mouth at [0.39, 0.62] and [0.47, 0.61]
details.why: they provide the sharpest value contrast in the painting against the black gullet

details.what: lavender-grey triangular nose pad with dark indigo nostrils
details.why: it anchors the snout in a cool muted tone amid the surrounding fire-orange and magenta fur

details.what: feathered dry-brush strokes running horizontally like phantom whiskers
details.why: the artist dragged a semi-dry pink brush across primed texture instead of drawing explicit whisker lines

details.what: slender streak of viridian green bridging the chin to the throat
details.why: an unexpected cool complementary hue wedged tightly between warm orange and magenta fields

unlike: It renders feline domesticity through a fractured Fauvist skin of clashing pure cadmiums, ultramarines, and magentas left floating unfinished on completely unpainted studio canvas.
